$comment: Where Scribe can send speech to be turned into tickets (src/lib/scribe.svelte.js). kind 'wordsmith' is wordsmith's own Worker running Workers AI (api/functions/api/scribe.js, models in scribe-cloud-models.json); kind 'openai' is any server that speaks OpenAI's chat API, on this machine (local: true, looked for at its default address) or anywhere else. A new provider is one more entry here.

providers.name: wordsmith cloud
providers.note: No setup. What you say goes as text to Cloudflare Workers AI through wordsmith, within a daily allowance.

providers.name: Ollama
providers.note: A model on this computer. Set it up with the repo's scribe:ollama script, or install Ollama from ollama.com and pull a model.

providers.name: LM Studio
providers.note: A model on this computer: start LM Studio's server and turn on CORS in its settings.

providers.name: llama.cpp
providers.note: A model on this computer: llama-server at its default address.

providers.name: Other
providers.note: Any server with an OpenAI-compatible chat API, here or online. An API key, if it needs one, stays on this device and goes only to that server.
